report_title: Floor Guard AI — Unseen Cross-Dataset Generalization Benchmark
evaluation_protocol: Strict held-out cross-dataset test set with zero overlap to training backgrounds
environments_tested: Industrial concrete factory floor with harsh sodium vapor lighting
Commercial shopping mall polished marble with high specular daylight reflections
Modern office laminate wood planks with multi-source overhead LED lighting
Hospital terrazzo corridors with high-gloss hygienic wax finish
Warehouse loading dock with oil stains, scuff marks, and rough asphalt transitions

unseen_flooring_materials.notes: Model localizes hazards regardless of wood, tile, concrete, or terrazzo floor pattern.

extreme_lighting_variations.notes: Chromatic normalization prevents dark shadow false alarms.

shallow_camera_angles.notes: Trained across perspective angles from 15 to 80 degrees.

curled_mat_vs_flat_mat_separation.notes: Zero bounding boxes on flat entrance mats; tight boxes on curled flaps.

cracked_concrete_vs_grout_line_separatio.notes: Tile grout lines rejected as safe; fracture craters detected.
